data.title: Dave & Buster's swings to a loss on negative comp sales, higher operating costs
data.description:
Higher food and beverage, payroll, and pre-opening costs eroded Dave & Buster’s (PLAY) profitability in the second quarter, driving the company into the red and underperforming Wall Street’s expectations.

Shares were underwater in after-hours trading, reflecting the disappointing financial results and negative comparable store sales.

The restaurant chain swung to an unexpected adjusted loss of $0.27 per share versus a profit of $0.40 per share a year ago, missing expectations for a profit of $0.19 per share. Adjusted EBITDA dropped to $98.9M from $129.8M in the same quarter last year, missing $118.8M estiamtes. .

Sales experienced a more modest decline of 2.4% year-over-year to $544.1M but were still less than anticipated as comparable store sales were down from a year ago. 

The results reflected lower entertainment revenue and increased food and beverage revenue, while at the same time, expenses increased across most of its items, with food and beverage costs up 11%, entertainment costs up 5%, and payroll costs up 1%. As a result, total operating expenses increased by 4%.

Dave & Buster’s (PLAY) balance sheet improved, however, generating positive adjusted free cash flow of $19.5M for the first six months of 2026 compared to negative $36.5M for the same period last year.

data.title: Veracyte acquiring Convergent Genomics in up to $180M deal
data.description:
• Veracyte (VCYT) has agreed to buy Convergent Genomics, which is focused on urologic cancer diagnostics, for $150M upfront.
  • The acquisition gives Veracyte, which provides cancer genomic tests, access to Convergent's UroAmp MRD, a urine test that can detect, monitor, and predict the risk of urothelial cancer or its recurrence well before signs and symptoms develop or become detectable.
  • So far, UroAmp MRD has been validated in non-muscle invasive bladder cancer.
  • Convergent could receive another $30M in milestone payments based on UroAmp reimbursement efforts.
  • Veracyte said it plans to expand use of UroAmp to other indications, such as intravesical maintenance therapy monitoring and surveillance following treatment with curative intent.

data.title: Bamboo Insurance announces plans to raise up to $700M in IPO
data.description:
Midvale, Utah-based Bamboo Insurance Services (BMB) is seeking to raise up to $700M through an initial public offering of class A shares.

The company said its selling stockholders are offering 35M shares, estimated to be priced between $18.00 per share and $20.00 per share.

The stocks are expected to be listed on the NYSE under the symbol BMB.

Bamboo Insurance does not expect to receive any proceeds from the sale of shares.

The company reported revenue totaling $173.4M during the six months ended June 30, 2026, up from $123.8M in the same period a year ago.

Net income stood at $13.8M, compared to $23.7M a year ago.

data.title: Chevron signs technical consultancy deal for Iraq’s huge West Qurna-2 oil field
data.description:
Iraq’s Oil Ministry said Monday it signed an agreement with Chevron (CVX) to provide technical consultancy services to the Basra Oil Company, as the U.S. company continues negotiations over taking operatorship of the West Qurna-2 oilfield from the state-run firm, the Iraqi News Agency reported.

Since the opening of its oil industry to international oil companies in 2009, Iraq has frequently used technical consultancy agreements, technical assistance agreements, and joint technical studies to involve Western companies, including Chevron (CVX), in managing its large transitioning fields before finalizing multi-billion dollar commercial operating contracts.

The new agreement entails providing technical expertise, evaluation data, and engineering advice during the negotiation period between Chevron (CVX) and Basra Oil over the development of West Qurna-2, which contains an estimated ~14B barrels of recoverable oil reserves.

Basra Oil took temporary operatorship of the giant oilfield after the previous operator, Russia's Lukoil, left the project last year when the U.S. imposed sanctions on the company and its international operations.

Talks between Chevron (CVX) and Basra Oil may continue until February 2027 after the Iraqi government in February granted the U.S. company one year to conclude exclusive talks to take over the West Qurna-2 operatorship.

data.title: Crown Castle names Kris Hinson CFO as Sunit Patel to retire; COO Cathy Piche to depart
data.description:
• Crown Castle (CCI) on Monday announced the retirement of CFO Sunit Patel, effective March 31, 2027.
  • Kris Hinson, who currently serves as Crown Castle’s EVP and chief commercial officer, will be appointed CFO effective April 1, 2027. 
  • Cathy Piche, EVP and chief operating officer, will leave Crown Castle to pursue other endeavors, the firm added. Piche will step down from the COO role effective September 23, 2026, and she will be available to the Company as a special advisor supporting the transition of her responsibilities until her departure on February 22, 2027. The company has initiated a search for her replacement.
  • Source: Press Release

data.title: Sysco announces $1B common stock offering
data.description:
Sysco Corporation (SYY) announced on Monday that it intends to make an offering of $1B of shares of its common stock. 

Sysco intends to grant the underwriters of the offering a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional $150M of shares of common stock, solely to cover overallotments, if any, at the same price per share as the other shares of common stock purchased by the underwriters in the offering.

Sysco intends to use the net proceeds from the offering to finance a portion of the consideration for its pending acquisition of Jetro Restaurant Depot.  

Shares of SYY slipped nearly 3% in extended trading.

Source: press release
